## Vesta 1.2.1

### Changes

- Lua scripts can press only game keys and only while CS2 is in focus: Windows, Alt, Escape, Enter, console, application and browser keys are refused, so a script can no longer type into other programs.
- `vesta.input.is_down` no longer reports keys pressed in other programs.
- Fixed a Lua script being able to freeze the menu or grow Vesta's memory through errors in API calls.
- Finalizers (`__gc`) are not available to sandboxed scripts.
- Limits on script storage, event handlers, config changes, texts and UI controls.
- A script package's entry file must stay inside its package folder.
- Vesta loads system libraries only from System32, never from the folder it was started from.
